changelog: **Fix (go-live):** a freshly invited MARKETING sales rep's first sign-in ended on a 404. The mentor dashboard stamped `mentorOnboardingSeenAt` and redirected to `/onboarding`, which a vertical without `mentorship` does not have; the page's redirect could beat the layout's own `/sales` redirect. The mentor page now sends a mentorship-less vertical on itself (`mentorlessShellTarget`) before the wizard check, and the sign-in form lands a sales rep straight on `/sales` (`postSignInHome()` in `src/lib/salesSurface.ts`; every other role and vertical keeps `roleHome()`). `e2e/marketing-rep-first-login.spec.ts` (@smoke) signs in a rep with the stamp unset, as an invitation leaves it (#3647).

en: Newly invited sales reps now land on their sales dashboard on their first sign-in instead of an error page.
tr: Yeni davet edilen satış temsilcileri ilk girişte artık hata sayfası yerine kendi satış panolarına iniyor.
de: Neu eingeladene Vertriebsmitarbeiter landen bei der ersten Anmeldung jetzt auf ihrem Vertriebs-Dashboard statt auf einer Fehlerseite.
